The Research Triangle Park market, where Durham sits at the center, remains highly competitive for project management talent, and certified professionals command a meaningful edge over non-credentialed peers—particularly in healthcare systems, pharmaceutical companies, and technology organizations. Completing Granite PM Academy's PMP Boot Camp positions you to meet this local credential demand head-on, equipping you with both the knowledge and the professional credential that Durham-area employers actively seek. content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Durham

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to verify your background qualifies. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can answer questions about your credentials and help you prepare a strong application.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions synchronously with experienced trainers who teach real-world Durham and Research Triangle project scenarios. You'll complete the PMI-required contact hours and build exam readiness in one cohesive program.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. Include proof of your contact-hour completion from Granite PM Academy, your work history, and the required exam fee. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Register with Pearson VUE for your PMP exam appointment. You'll take the computer-based exam remotely or at a testing center in the Durham area.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout PMI's standard renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and workshops to help you accumulate the PDUs you need. Plan your continuing education early so renewal stays manageable alongside your Durham-area project-management role.
